## 2.6.5 hotfix

- Fixed auto-crouch so the saved disable state no longer resets after opening Feature Settings
- Fixed hide objective beam so runtime sync respects the saved launcher setting
- Fixed replay browser multi-select delete in the Avalonia launcher
- Fixed Import Folder in the Avalonia replacers to recurse folders, copy files into the correct Custom* directory, and preserve relative paths
- Reduced texture replacer runtime overhead by switching from endless polling to short startup and scene-load scan bursts
- Fixed local build preview crate confirmations so floating indestructible local-only blocks no longer persist after fast crate placement
